title: COL2: bounded all-moduli collimation with linear quantum space

claims.statement: For COL2 in proof.md, label-tools.md and gradient-tools.md, for every N>=2 and s in Z/NZ let n=ceil(log2 N). Use its exact finite branch for n<4096 and its fully specified large-branch parameters, depth-first collimation, literal-frequency selection, all-moduli recovery and global source/work caps for n>=4096. Unconditional entire-secret success is greater than 2/3. On every execution branch the SAME configuration has total charged sequential work T=O(n^8 2^((325/4) sqrt n)), jointly with all other resource bounds and clean-input tolerance below. All outside constants are absolute. The supported envelope has exact growth index 1/2. Complete charged classical/circuit generation, addressing, initialization, quantum scratch, preparation, precision and all unsuccessful attempts are proved in the evidence.

Every acquired copy is an independent ideal coset state. Under this promise unconditional full-secret success is greater than 2/3 and all four resource bounds hold jointly on every branch, including source/work-clock aborts. No positive-corruption guarantee or maximum-tolerance impossibility is asserted.

structured.error_model: Malformed-sample count among Q acquired copies. The proved guarantee requires every copy to be an independent ideal coset state; no behavior is promised for malformed copies.
